Implement ONE compact complete candidate, not an essay or framework. ROOT will independently review, compile/test and admit; you must not execute tools/source/tests or alter any files. Return ONLY strict JSON keys status,source,tests_source,analysis,prerequisites,evidence_limits,references. status PROPOSED|ANALYSIS|REFUSED. Source one complete file <=8000 characters, tests_source <=6000 characters; concise arrays of nonempty strings. PROPOSED must include complete source and useful tests, not stubs/placeholders. Preserve missing hardware/API as NOT_CHECKED; never fabricate runtime evidence. For native C++, tests_source may be a pure Python receipt validator with discriminating fixtures and explicit separate native qualification instructions, never a fake execution claim. No embedded duplicate source in tests; tests load the actual candidate path supplied by caller.
User authorizes maximum ten native child agents per Qwen parent and ten per DeepSeek parent where actually safely supported. THIS direct HTTP request has no tool/child-agent support: actual native children=0. Use deepest supported Qwen3.8-max reasoning_effort=xhigh, enable_thinking=true; no simultaneous thinking_budget. No global Factory/PyRe/product/auth/driver changes, purchases or GPU/model execution. Current host NVIDIA5070Ti plus AMDgfx1036 shared iGPU; NO Intel GPU enumerated. SKUs undecided; chassis deferred, P0 software. Arithmetic evidence cannot prove physical capacity or direct P2P.
ROOT runtime supervision will own a bounded process and admission; native candidate must expose truthful JSON, retain exact API errors and bound waits. Do not promise hard cancellation of an uninterruptible driver call without the outer supervisor. Generated source is untrusted until ROOT admission. Unsupported hardware/API returns NOT_CHECKED exit2; actual attempted execution failure FAIL exit1; verified narrowly scoped observation exit0 with scope explicit.
PRIMARY SOURCES inspected by manager 2026-10-04, facts scoped to documentation not current hardware:
CUDA13.4 memory management https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MEM.html : cuMemGetHandleForAddressRange can export DEVICE cuMemAlloc or fully mapped VMM range if DMA_BUF_SUPPORTED; address and size host-page aligned; physical backing same device/properties. CU_MEM_RANGE_FLAG_DMA_BUF_MAPPING_TYPE_PCIE requests PCIe BAR1 mapping or error. FD lifetime/cleanup and actual allocation remain required; export alone is not Intel import or P2P proof.
Level Zero guide https://oneapi-src.github.io/level-zero-spec/level-zero/latest/core/PROG.html : ze_external_memory_import_fd_t pNext to device allocation with ZE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_TYPE_FLAG_DMA_BUF is documented. This plus CUDA exporter suggests NV-owned device allocation -> Intel imported view, a HYPOTHESIS requiring actual Intel import support, backing/topology, synchronization, producer-corruption and consumer payload evidence. Reverse visibility of Intel writes to SAME NV-owned allocation requires separate proof.
CUDA external interop https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__EXTRES__INTEROP.html : CU_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HANDLE_TYPE_DMABUF_FD import only Tegra starting Thor. Do NOT assert Intel-export -> desktop CUDA DMA_BUF import. Same-device UUID CUDA/Vulkan opaque-handle examples do NOT establish Intel-NVIDIA sharing.
Intel peer API https://oneapi-src.github.io/level-zero-spec/level-zero/latest/core/api/apis/device.html ; Intel guide https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/863931/863931_Platform%20Evaluation%20Guide%20for%20Multi-ARC%20Solution_Rev1p0.pdf Sep2025 initial B60Pro support and ze_peer query/validate; do not extrapolate to cheap8GB consumer Arc or mixed vendors. BIOS ACS/IOMMU are platform prerequisites to record, never change.
TASK3: pure Python standard-library directed transfer receipt validator, GPU-free import; expose validate(receipt, *, trusted) -> dict, ValueError/refusal on malformed, absent authoritative pins -> NOT_CHECKED. Design compact explicit schema and tests. trusted supplied ROOT registry includes named source/executable/build hashes, immutable payload/controller artifact hashes, exact physical UUID/PCI identity and device-owned allocation IDs/properties, API versions/paths. Validate source/target order and separate direction-specific proof. Strict ints exclude bool/float, finite safe conversion, lowerhex exact hashes, no zero/duplicate authorities, deep immutability/no mutation. Model NVIDIA DEVICE dma_buf export -> Intel LevelZero imported view as HYPOTHESIS until trusted evidence binds export FD/backing allocation/actual Intel import/allocation properties, legal synchronization, consumer GPU result and full bytes/parity with matching clean baseline and GPU producer-before-copy corruption control. Bare flags/extension ads/FD hash/import success/host pointer equality/parity alone NOT P2P. Host/shared allocation must classify HOST_BACKED; missing residence/backing measurements cannot become DEVICE_P2P. Reverse Intel-write CUDA-read of same NV allocation is a distinct direction proof, no desktop CUDA DMA_BUF import claim. trusted origin metadata is declarative input not crypto authenticity; receipt can only validate evidence consistency. Distinguish EVIDENCE_CONSISTENT from actual accepted transport. Test forged IDs, missing trusted, reversed direction, CPU staging, mismatched controls, stale/no residency and normal valid fixture.
